name: The Bridge
description: Three consoles are lit: the {exit}helm{/}, the {exit}reactor{/} and the {exit}scan{/} station. The rest of the deck is dark. {hint}(go helm, go reactor, go scan){/}

name: Helm
description: The hopper's controls, slaved to this console.

on_sim_done.say: The hopper is down on the pad.

on_sim_fail.say: The console goes dark, and comes back with the hopper where it started.

on_sim_done.say: The core holds at power. The lights on the deck come up.

on_sim_fail.say: The core scrams itself. It will take a while to coax back.

on_sim_done.say: The mast below is whole in the scope: somebody built it, and it is still standing.

on_sim_fail.say: The pass is over and the picture is not whole. Next orbit.
